acceptance: every error crossing a layer boundary is the google.rpc.Status envelope { error: { code, status, message, details } } — never an ad-hoc shape like { error: 'string' } or a bare text/HTTP body
status is one of the canonical enum values and code is its matching HTTP integer; a consumer can branch on status without parsing message

exactly one reason registry exists per side, and every app-specific failure resolves its reason there — each reason maps to a status + HTTP code in that one place, with no inline bespoke numeric/string code
app-specific codes appear only as details[].ErrorInfo.reason, never as a bespoke top-level name / codeNumber / sibling field

every raw or upstream failure is normalized to the envelope where it crosses the boundary — no raw driver text, stack trace, or internal identifier leaks, and DebugInfo appears only in sandbox/dev, never a prod client response
human message text comes from the reason to text dictionary (extracted, i18n-ready), not hardcoded string literals at throw sites
the client branches on status / reason only; no code path keys off a message substring or a magic number to decide UX
adding a new failure adds exactly one reason entry — registry + dictionary — in a single change, not duplicated across call sites or re-declared per layer
